guarantees.claim: msg_mask_o always equals the least significant MsgWidth bits of rand_data_q.
When aux_update is 1, aux_rand_d receives the bit of rand_data_q indexed by (EntropyOutputW - 1); otherwise it holds the current aux_rand_q.

assumptions.claim: MsgWidth must not exceed the bit-width of rand_data_q, otherwise the slice rand_data_q[MsgWidth-1:0] is out of range.
assumptions.risk: Out-of-range bit-select may cause synthesis/X propagation, leading to an invalid mask and potential data corruption.

assumptions.claim: EntropyOutputW must be at least 1 and not exceed the bit-width of rand_data_q, otherwise rand_data_q[EntropyOutputW - 1] is illegal.
assumptions.risk: Invalid bit-select can produce X or synthesis errors, breaking the auxiliary randomness update and possibly leaking a fixed value.

uncertain_points.claim: The auxiliary randomness update uses only a single bit from rand_data_q (the one at index EntropyOutputW-1), which may be insufficient for entropy accumulation if aux_rand_q is multi-bit.
uncertain_points.risk: Slow or biased auxiliary randomness update could weaken side‑channel protection or statistical quality.
